title: Require Domain Module Router Binding Shape
forbids: semantic-module router files delegating through an implementation registry, exposing leaf implementations, or owning any authority besides one direct createDomainSubdomainRouter binding
why: The semantic module router is already the rightful executable aggregate. It binds canonical leaf implementations directly to the module contract, eliminating a second registry authority without leaking operation internals.
remediate: Import createDomainSubdomainRouter, the local module contract, and each leaf ./ops/<operation>/index.js implementation; bind the implementations inline once and default-export only that router.
message: Domain module router.ts must expose one default implementation binding only.
